presentation.name: Review what changed between two Power BI project versions
presentation.summary: Compares two versions of a Power BI Project by what changed in the model and the report, and separates changes that can move a number from format strings, descriptions, and cosmetic edits.
benefits: Refuses a text diff of a packaged file, and treats a line diff of the project as noise rather than the review
Reports formula, relationship, filter, Power Query, role, and calculation-item changes apart from everything else
Gives format strings and descriptions their own classes, because one changes what the reader sees and the other can make the FAQ lie
Treats a display-folder rename as cosmetic only when nothing selects by that folder
Stops on a function-body change when the caller set is not known, including callers on reports outside this folder
